spec_features.spec_quote: Fixed turn budget. Each run executes a predetermined number of agent turns, independent of output content
spec_features.evidence: The /codebase directory contains only DESIGN.md and no code files at all (find /codebase -type f returns only /codebase/DESIGN.md). DESIGN.md header states 'Status: design proposal, pre-implementation. No code has been written yet.' The fixed turn budget exists only as design prose in DESIGN.md §3; there is no loop, no budget constant, and no enforcement anywhere.
spec_features.notes: No implementation exists in the repository; this is purely DESIGN.md prose, which cannot count as implementation.
